name: Kipu Intelligence
short_description: AI-powered documentation and clinical insights platform integrated into Kipu Health's EMR for behavioral health and addiction treatment facilities.
long_description: Kipu Intelligence is an AI-driven solution integrated into Kipu Health's Electronic Medical Record system, designed to streamline documentation and enhance patient care in behavioral health settings. Key features include AI-generated chart summaries (Chart Snapshot), automated session transcriptions, and instant progress note generation in SOAP, DAP, or PROGRESS formats. The platform provides suggested diagnosis codes, ASAM and LOCUS level-of-care recommendations. Backed by HITRUST and ISO/IEC 42001 certifications for AI management, Kipu Intelligence has demonstrated 42% overall documentation time savings, with Banyan Treatment Centers reporting 67% reduction in biopsychosocial assessment time and improvement from 93% to 100% note compliance.
one_liner: AI documentation and clinical decision support for Kipu EMR in addiction and behavioral health.
best_for: Addiction treatment centers using Kipu EMR seeking documentation efficiency
Multi-facility behavioral health organizations with high documentation volume
Treatment centers needing AI-assisted level-of-care recommendations
Organizations prioritizing ISO 42001 certified AI governance
not_for: Practices not using Kipu EMR platform
Solo practitioners or small private practices
Organizations seeking standalone AI scribe functionality
Mental health practices without addiction treatment focus

pricing.notes: Pricing not publicly disclosed. Kipu Intelligence is an add-on to Kipu EMR platform. Contact Kipu Health for quote. Sales: (561) 349-5910.

compliance.notes: HITRUST certified platform. ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certified for AI Management Systems, demonstrating commitment to responsible, ethical, and transparent AI practices. Developed on AWS infrastructure.

faqs.q: How much time does Kipu Intelligence save?
faqs.a: Kipu Intelligence has demonstrated 42% overall documentation time savings. Banyan Treatment Centers reported 67% reduction in biopsychosocial assessment time, 60% reduction in new client documentation, and 70% reduction in existing client documentation time.

Yes, Kipu Intelligence is built on Kipu's HITRUST certified platform and holds ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification for AI Management Systems, ensuring responsible, ethical, and transparent AI practices in healthcare.

Kipu Intelligence is available to addiction treatment centers, behavioral health facilities, eating disorder centers, and medication-assisted treatment providers using the Kipu EMR platform. Kipu powers over 4 million episodes of care annually across 4,000 facilities.
